title: Sinus pressure louder today?
caption: Sinus pressure louder today? The day feels a little wobbly, not a storm—so dim bright screens, close your eyes for short slow-breathing breaks, and space out the big tasks.
snapshot: Geomagnetic conditions are quiet overall. The magnetic field has leaned southward at times, which can add a mild unsettled feel. Solar wind is running at typical speeds. No solar flares or CMEs were reported, and the baseline resonance is near its usual level.
affects: Head pressure and sinus fullness can be more noticeable for some. Light and screen glare may feel harsher than usual, which can add to the sense of pressure. Noise sensitivity can stack with this pattern, making busy spaces feel like too much.
playbook:
- Lower screen brightness and reduce glare
- Short slow-breathing breaks with eyes closed
- Steady hydration and easy, unhurried movement
- Check local pressure and humidity swings
- Keep fragrances and loud spaces to a minimum
